claims.summary: Native Pass A prompt and parser now prevent modality-only section titles from becoming course-map topics.
Anchored psychology kernels now cover broad audited titles such as learning, memory, and cognitive bias.
Research methods is restored as a foundry-owned manifest shard, enabling research ethics and informed-consent links.
Focused tests pin the audited Intro Psychology topic mix so it infers the right shards and links anchored concepts.

Make citations and feedback loops first-class CourseIR atoms so the compiler can prove the full source-to-feedback chain.
